rules.sentence: For patients with an unknown syphilis history, the initial step in diagnosing neurosyphilis involves confirming the presence of T pallidum infection.
While nontreponemal tests tend to be positive in early neurosyphilis, they may yield nonreactive results in late-stage neurosyphilis.
Therefore, to evaluate suspected cases of tabes dorsalis, it is crucial to perform treponemal antibody tests.
